card.name: Start of a repeated or new table entry
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word or number that begins a new entry right after a heading or dose row, often repeating the previous heading (e.g. 'Adult' after 'Adult Patients'). Seen in dosing tables and, less often, in web page headings.

modes.label: Number starting a dose cell
modes.description: A leading digit '1' that begins a split number such as 12 or 10 in dosing tables.

modes.label: Repeated heading word
modes.description: A word that repeats or follows a table heading, right after the heading text with no space.
modes.example: Dosage Adult Patients<<Adult>> Patients 10 mg four times daily

modes.label: Sentence start after a period
modes.description: A new sentence's first piece, run on directly after a period or question.
modes.example: The maximum recommended daily dosage is 60 mg<<.The>> recommended adult dosage of metoclopr

card.plain: It fires at the very start of a new entry in a dosing table or list, where the text restarts or repeats a heading.
